title: SAMpLE: A SystemC-AMS Machine LEarning-based Framework for Virtual Prototyping
abstract: arXiv:2608.25910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly used in virtual prototypes of embedded systems to model behaviors that are difficult to capture analytically. However, integrating ML models into virtual platform simulation is still typically done through ad hoc solutions, which limits reuse, comparability, and reproducibility. This paper presents \textbf{\textit{SAMpLE}}, an open-source SystemC-AMS-based framework that integrates ML models as first-class Timed Dataflow (TDF) components through a standardized plug-and-play interface. SAMpLE provides two execution backends: a native C++ backend for online training of lightweight models, and an offline backend for executing externally developed models without requiring re-implementation in C++ or manual integration steps. translated_title: SAMpLE：一种基于SystemC-AMS机器学习的虚拟原型设计框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）越来越多地用于嵌入式系统的虚拟原型中，以模拟难以解析建模的行为。然而，将ML模型集成到虚拟平台仿真中通常仍通过临时解决方案完成，这限制了重用性、可比性和可复现性。本文介绍了\textbf{\textit{SAMpLE}}，一个基于SystemC-AMS的开源框架，通过标准化的即插即用接口，将ML模型作为一等公民的定时数据流（TDF）组件集成。SAMpLE提供两种执行后端：一种用于轻量级模型在线训练的原生C++后端，以及一种用于执行外部开发模型而无需在C++中重新实现或手动集成步骤的离线后端。该框架使用ONNX作为标准模型交换格式，使外部训练的ML模型能够集成到SystemC-AMS仿真中，并允许评估不同的ML模型。
tldr: 该论文提出SAMpLE框架，通过标准化的即插即用接口和ONNX格式，将机器学习模型无缝集成到SystemC-AMS虚拟原型仿真中，支持在线和离线执行，提高了可重用性和可复现性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SAMpLE, a framework that integrates machine learning models into SystemC-AMS virtual prototyping via standardized plug-and-play interfaces and ONNX format, enabling online and offline execution for enhanced reusability and reproducibility.
